label.zh: 我们是解放者，而非征服者。
我们是解放者，而非征服者。

texts.zh: 在击溃了[conquered_planet.GetName]的守军后，[From.GetName]的地面部队以大可汗之名占领了[conquered_planet.GetPlanetMoon]！他们在[conquered_planet.GetPlanetMoon]地表上的主要定居点高高升起这个新兴帝国的旗帜。现在，[From.GetSpeciesName]的殖民者们被赶出了他们已被摧毁的居住地，装进了运输舰中。
texts.en: After defeating the brave defenders of [conquered_planet.GetName], ground forces from the [From.GetName] have claimed the [conquered_planet.GetPlanetMoon] in the name of their Great Khan! They have raised the banner of their new empire over every major settlement on the [conquered_planet.GetPlanetMoon]'s surface. Even now, [From.GetSpeciesName] colonists are being ferried in from their decaying space habitats.

label.en: The Great Khan must be stopped!

texts.zh: 我们的军队成功从可汗军手中解放了[liberated_planet.GetName]！现在[liberated_planet.GetPlanetMoon]终于回到了我们的掌控中。
texts.en: Our forces have successfully liberated [liberated_planet.GetName] from its occupation by the Great Khan's soldiery! The [liberated_planet.GetPlanetMoon] has finally been returned to our full control.

texts.zh:
在我们击败可汗在[liberated_planet.GetName]地表上全部军队后，我们的部队完全控制了这个[liberated_planet.GetPlanetMoon]。

在可汗的军队占领[raider_khanate.GetName]之前，这个星球曾属于[planet_former_owner.GetName]。如果我们将星球归还给他们，他们或许会很感激。
texts.en:
We have defeated the last of the Great Khan's soldiers on the surface of [liberated_planet.GetName], and our forces are now in full control of the [liberated_planet.GetPlanetMoon].

Before it was seized by the [raider_khanate.GetName], this world belonged to the [planet_former_owner.GetName]. They would likely be grateful to us if we returned it to their rule.

label.en: To the victor go the spoils.

label.zh: 我们是解放者，而非征服者。

texts.zh: 在我们击败可汗在[liberated_planet.GetName]地表上全部军队后，我们的部队完全控制了这个[liberated_planet.GetPlanetMoon]。
texts.en: We have defeated the last of the Great Khan's soldiers on the surface of [liberated_planet.GetName], and our forces are now in full control of the [liberated_planet.GetPlanetMoon].

texts.zh: 在成功的进攻并击败了[liberated_planet.GetName]上的可汗军后，[From.GetName]向我们和善地提出归还[liberated_planet.GetPlanetMoon]控制权的请求。
texts.en: After successfully storming [liberated_planet.GetName] and defeating the Great Khan's forces stationed on its surface, the [From.GetName] has graciously offered to restore the [liberated_planet.GetPlanetMoon] to our full control.
